title: The Fourth, 2018 · after
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
logline: The morning after the Fourth with her seat left empty on purpose: Gully asking why the strip had an empty stool on the dock, since there's no stool on the dock. Wood says there was. Gully says there wasn't. The strip, which drew it, doesn't take sides.

panels.composition: Gully's. GULLY with yesterday's strip on the counter. WOOD on the end stool. The PUP.

balloons.text: There's no stool on the dock. You drew a stool.
